verdict.rationale: Supabase publishes a documented Management API, described by an OpenAPI 3.0 spec at supabase.com/openapi.json, for managing organizations, projects, branches, and configuration. A probe confirmed that spec is live (HTTP 200 with an 'openapi' key), and Advisors are also exposed through the Management API. Each project additionally gets auto-generated REST and GraphQL data APIs, so the product can be driven programmatically end to end. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence of the Management API's auth model and endpoint coverage, and independent hands-on reports of agents driving it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
